Priority Application Update
Priority applications are currently being reviewed. You will receive an update by email if selected for an interview.
Application Fee Waiver Policy
All US citizens or permanent residents are eligible to apply free of charge through October 15th. Application fee waivers are not available to international students. US armed forces veterans, CWRU employees, students (including CWRU international students), and alumni can apply free of charge, and should contact bstp@case.edu.
